serviceability_vlm.scope: image-visible serviceability only, model evidence, not proof of unseen/night condition or historical replacement
serviceability_vlm.recheck_policy: All initial unserviceable predictions independently re-read as single images; blur or uncertainty does not establish a functional defect.

object_level_condition.identity_policy: Complete-link XY clustering maximum 1m diameter, class family compatible; same-frame disjoint boxes prevent merge; at least 2 independent frames and an accepted bbox required for stable location. Weak views attach only through unique reprojection into their box. These are inferred identities, not manually verified physical IDs.
object_level_condition.condition_policy: At least one clear serviceable observation plus no conflicting clear defect supports object-level visible serviceability; uncertain images do not negate that. Propagation requires multiframe-supported identity.

initial_diagnostic.reason: Do not use per-frame acquired status as geometry acceptance. Calibration, coordinate conventions, synchronization and foreground depth association require diagnosis; root cause not established.

validated_sign_geometry.scope: three observed approach signs only; not channelizer/taper reconstruction
fixes: INS attitude: Y-forward NovAtel vehicle convention Rz(-azimuth) Rx(pitch) Ry(roll), instead of X-forward xyz(roll,pitch,90-azimuth)
Raw point timestamps transformed directly to ENU using interpolated corrected INS pose; old deskewed clouds bypassed
Select nearest raw LiDAR timestamp to each camera timestamp instead of sample_token pairing about 100 ms apart
Central diamond ROI and nearest-depth cluster; minimum point support and cross-frame consistency gates
validated_sign_geometry.uncertainty_note: Sensitivity envelope uses full observed station range plus an explicit 1 m endpoint allowance. This is not a calibrated statistical confidence interval or survey accuracy guarantee; systematic calibration error is not independently surveyed.

geometry_validation.other_geometry_status: channelizer spacing measured; taper estimated with overlapping sensitivity envelopes

tangent_spacing.limitation: Observed straight run only; provisional interior anchor explicit. No extrapolation to unseen facilities or transition spacing.

taper.model: continuous linear taper followed by constant lateral channelizer line in trajectory coordinates
taper.note: W is the estimated channelizer lateral shift relative to driven trajectory, not an independently surveyed lane width. L uses fitted transition endpoint; full lane-edge/endpoint semantics and systematic uncertainty prevent a definitive pass/fail when envelopes overlap. Sensitivity ranges are not calibrated confidence intervals.

termination_visual_review.finding: Observed posts end alongside the work-space boundary; later clear frames show the lane reopened without a channelizer sequence guiding traffic back to its original lane. No downstream taper identified in captured termination.
termination_visual_review.scope: captured main approach only; no claim about other approaches

requirements.title: 封道预告牌在封道前方
requirements.reason: 帧 62–83 的 RIGHT LANE CLOSED AHEAD 位于帧 375 起可见的交叉口远侧封道之前。此结论限本次行驶方向。

requirements.title: 单条右车道关闭的标志文字
requirements.reason: 人工确认的 22 个框中可读到 RIGHT LANE CLOSED AHEAD，与右车道关闭一致。

requirements.title: 预告标志间距：100 ft（指导值）
requirements.reason: 已修正 INS 坐标约定、逐点运动补偿及时间配对，并验证三块标志的跨帧稳定性。ROAD WORK AHEAD → RIGHT LANE CLOSED 为 86.66 m（284.3 ft）；RIGHT LANE CLOSED → 并道标志为 78.74 m（258.3 ft）。两段保守敏感性范围的下界均大于 100 ft，观察范围内支持符合该指导值。

requirements.title: 直线段导流设施间距：不超过 50 ft
requirements.reason: 已对重建直线段（轨迹里程 319.87–434.22 m）的 17 组相邻设施测距：最大 12.57 m，敏感性范围上界最大 13.57 m，均小于 15.24 m（50 ft）。其中 OBJ_014 为人工确认的单帧设施，位置暂定并采用更宽余量；其余采用多帧实体。结论限已观察直线段。

requirements.title: 不再适用的导流设施应更换
requirements.reason: 已按物理对象候选汇总 Qwen 图像证据：25 个多帧关联可靠的设施对象至少有一张清晰可用视图，且无明确缺陷冲突；原先 56 个不清晰观察中，38 个已由同一对象的清晰视图补足，不再作为该对象无法判断的理由。另有 2 个多帧设施对象尚无模型可判断的清晰视图；单帧及身份未确定者单独保留。未发现明确失效设施。
requirements.missing_evidence: 仅对没有清晰视图的对象或身份关联不可靠的观察保留不确定，不因同一对象的某一帧模糊而否定其清晰证据。

requirements.title: TA-22 中 W4-2R 的位置与顺序
requirements.source_locator: Figure 6P-22 (TA-22); PDF page 943; component sign:W4-2R; Guidance basis SEC-6P.01 paragraph 02
requirements.reason: 右侧并道图案可见于帧 138、150、157；位于 RIGHT LANE CLOSED 之后、交叉口及远侧封道之前，支持 TA-22 主行驶方向的图示顺序。此行不判断标志间距。

requirements.title: 设施保持清洁、可见并正确设置
requirements.reason: 直接按本次图片判断：复核 164 个已接受的导流设施观察及场景上下文，清晰可辨的设施色带可见，未见明显影响识别的污损、倒伏或侵入通行路径的错置。局部倾斜未显示明显丧失导向作用。末段逆光、模糊小图不作为正向证据；综合清晰视图，观察范围内支持符合。

requirements.title: 并道渐变段长度公式
requirements.reason: 已拟合渐变段：长度 L≈41.02 m，横向偏移 W≈4.28 m。25 mph 下公式给出 L≈44.56 m。长度敏感性范围 38.02–44.02 m，要求值随 W 变化为 36.75–52.37 m，范围重叠，不能确认符合或不符合。
requirements.missing_evidence: W 为相对车辆轨迹的设施横向位移估计；尚非独立测得的道路横向偏移。渐变段端点与 W 的系统误差仍影响临界判断。

requirements.title: 双向交替单车道渐变段 50–100 ft
requirements.reason: 原条文 6B.08¶14 继承双向交通交替使用单车道的上下文。当前观察为分隔道路同向右车道关闭，不属于该场景；不能将此长度范围直接用于本处并道渐变段。
requirements.missing_evidence: 已纠正先前抽取后适用性判断的上下文问题，保留原条文以供追溯。

requirements.title: ROAD WORK AHEAD 在工作区之前
requirements.reason: 帧 0–29 的 ROAD WORK AHEAD 已人工确认，随后才到封道预告、交叉口和施工区。

requirements.title: 并道渐变段提供足够预告与并道距离
requirements.reason: 预告标志的顺序和距离得到支持；渐变段长度约 41.02 m，与按估计横向偏移计算的 44.56 m 接近。结合第 8 条的敏感性范围，目前不能确认并道距离充分，也不能确认不足。
requirements.missing_evidence: 同第 8 条：需进一步约束渐变段端点与道路横向偏移；有预告标志不等于并道距离必然充足。

requirements.title: 多块预告牌中 ROAD WORK AHEAD 最先遇到
requirements.reason: 在记录覆盖的主行驶方向，先遇 ROAD WORK AHEAD（0–29），再遇 RIGHT LANE CLOSED AHEAD（62–83），再遇右侧并道标志（近距 132–160）。不外推到未拍摄的其他入口。

requirements.title: 若设置下游渐变段，其长度及间距
requirements.reason: 已复核末段帧 500–631，重点查看 560、564、570、575 等清晰视图。设施沿施工边界结束，随后车道开放，未识别到将车辆导回原车道的下游渐变设施序列。该条以“若设置”为前提，在本次拍摄主行驶方向不适用。
requirements.missing_evidence: 不外推到未拍摄的其他入口或施工时段。
